item.title: GAME STORY: Carrillo’s late layup lifts Cooper to come-from-behind win in crucial matchup with Wichita Falls Legacy
item.description: Jaden Carrillo only had one field goal in the Cooper boys basketball team’s must-win matchup with Wichita Falls Legacy on Tuesday at Cougar Gym. But it was the most important bucket of the game in a dramatic 34-33 win for the Cougars. With his team trailing by a point after a J’Quan Carroll free throw […]

item.title: GAME STORY: Stephenville sweeps Glen Rose in varsity doubleheader
item.description: STEPHENVILLE — With area rival Glen Rose paying them a visit on Tuesday, the Stephenville Honey Bees and Yellow Jackets made the most of the annual occasion by sweeping a varsity doubleheader at Gandy Gymnasium. In the case of the Honey Bees (20-12, 5-5) their 30-19 win changed nothing in the way of playoff seeding. […]
